title: Local Knots, $ν^+$-Sharp Knots, and Rational Slice Genus
summary: Hom and Wu introduced the knot concordance invariant $ν^{+}$ for knots in $S^{3}$ and proved that it gives a lower bound for the slice genus. Wu and Yang extended $ν^{+}$ to knots in rational homology $3$-spheres, where it gives a lower bound for the rational slice genus, an analogue of the slice genus for knots in rational homology $3$-spheres. We call a knot $ν^{+}$-sharp if this bound is realized as an equality.
